queries.title: Search terms
queries.description: One Flipkart search per term, e.g. iphone 17, running shoes, office chair, 55 inch tv.

searchUrls.title: Or Flipkart search / category URLs
searchUrls.description: Search or category pages copied from flipkart.com with your filters set, e.g. flipkart.com/mobiles/pr?sid=tyy,4io or flipkart.com/search?q=shoes&p[]=facets.brand%5B%5D%3DADIDAS.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Order of results for search terms. URLs keep their own sort.

includeSponsored.title: Include sponsored products
includeSponsored.description: Keep the ads Flipkart mixes into results. They are flagged with isSponsored either way.

includeDetails.title: Full specifications and seller
includeDetails.description: Reads each product page for the full specification table, seller name and rating, colour and return policy. Costs $0.003 per product instead of $0.001.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Max products per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: Stop each search after this many products.
